TTA.value: HbbTV 2.0-based IBB service: application signaling per ETSI TS 102 809 / TS 102 796 with ROUTE/DASH and MMT carriage

SBTVD.clause: OG-08 §6 architecture; §7 Ginga Common Core; Annex A NCL 4.0; Annex B; Annex C TV 3.0 WebServices; Annex D NCLua
SBTVD.value: Ginga (NCL 4.0 + NCLua + HTML/WebServices) application coding; harmonization with TV 2.X Ginga

difference: Three different runtimes: A/344 Broadcaster Application (HTML5 + WebSocket/JSON-RPC), Korea's HbbTV-based IBB, Brazil's Ginga. Only the ATSC signaling substrate (ROUTE/DASH, NRT) is shared.
impact: Applications are not portable across the three markets; receivers need market-specific application engines.

ATSC.value: WebSocket JSON-RPC methods (content recovery, DRM, event stream, media player, receiver settings, caption/audio preferences …)

SBTVD.value: REST/WebServices API groups plus NCLua libraries

difference: API models differ entirely (JSON-RPC over WebSocket vs OIPF/HbbTV DOM objects vs Ginga WebServices/NCLua).
